svg.text: The default model writes 5.1 fewer builds per species than training,

text.style: font-size:17px;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;font-weight:600;

svg.text: yet its teams sit 11.5 fields further from the closest training team

svg.text: Model and training bars are means of three sampling seeds or three training draws. One team repeated is a

text.style: font-size:12px;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;font-weight:400;

svg.text: training team, so its distance is to the next closest training team.
